Documentation.UserDocu:
exportDXF(path)
Write the flat as DXF R12: the outline on the layer OUTLINE, the inner contours on INNER, the bend lines on BEND_UP and BEND_DOWN, each labelled with its bend's name on LABELS; with TangentLines each bend's tangent lines on BEND_TANGENT, with Grain the grain arrow on GRAIN.

exportSVG(path)
Write the flat as SVG, in mm, looking down on it: the DXF's layers as groups (Inkscape layers) of the same names.
